body:
Blackstone Inc. stock (ISIN US09259E1082) closed at USD 124.00 on the NYSE on September 20, 2026, after a senior executive sold about USD 12 million of shares. The price stood between a 52-week low near USD 90 and a high near USD 140, while the latest quarterly figures pointed to continued fee growth.

Insider sale tests valuation

According to AD HOC NEWS on September 21, 2026, Joseph Baratta, Global Head of Private Equity Strategies and a director, sold approximately 97,000 shares at an average price of USD 124, generating about USD 12 million in proceeds.

The transaction matters because the closing price was roughly 11 percent below the 52-week high and about 38 percent above the low. At USD 124.00, Blackstone carried a market capitalization of USD 80.0 billion as of September 20, 2026, leaving valuation expectations tied to continued growth in management and performance fees.

Fee income grows faster than realizations

Blackstone's second-quarter 2026 reporting period ended June 30, 2026. Recent coverage described total revenue in the mid-single-digit billions of USD and distributable earnings in the low billions of USD, with both figures modestly above the comparable quarter a year earlier.

Fee-related earnings rose at a mid-teens percentage rate year over year in Q2 2026, according to AD HOC NEWS. That comparison is important: the more stable fee stream expanded faster than net realizations, which remained comparatively subdued because exits depend on market conditions and transaction activity.

Scale supports the earnings case

Blackstone reported total assets under management of approximately USD 1.346 trillion and fee-earning assets under management of USD 961.6 billion as of June 2026, according to Tickeron. The scale broadens exposure across private equity, real estate, credit and insurance, but it also leaves earnings sensitive to fundraising, interest rates and the timing of asset sales.

Tickeron listed an expected Blackstone earnings date of October 15, 2026. Its comparison page showed a September 21, 2026 price of USD 126.41, a daily gain of USD 1.44 or 1.15 percent, and market capitalization of USD 99.71 billion, although those figures differ from the September 20 NYSE closing data used as the article's reference price.

Stock remains near the range midpoint

Blackstone stock closed at USD 124.00 on the NYSE as of September 20, 2026. The combination of mid-teens fee-related earnings growth, subdued realizations and a USD 12 million insider sale leaves valuation and exit activity as the main counterweights to the firm's expanding fee base.
